dxr_mc_extras.configuration.outline.alph: Opacity of the outline colour (0-255). 255 draws the outline in the solid phase, where terrain depth-tests it and can hide it behind blocks; below 255 it stays translucent and is drawn after terrain, so it remains visible through blocks.
dxr_mc_extras.configuration.outline.blue: Blue channel of the outline colour (0-255).
dxr_mc_extras.configuration.outline.enab: Apply the colour and width below to the block selection outline. OFF keeps the vanilla outline.
dxr_mc_extras.configuration.outline.gree: Green channel of the outline colour (0-255).
Red channel of the outline colour (0-255).
dxr_mc_extras.configuration.outline.tool: Colour and line width of the block selection outline. The defaults match vanilla.
dxr_mc_extras.configuration.outline.widt: 5 is the vanilla outline thickness (1-20); the window's own outline width scales it, so the outline keeps the same visual weight on a HiDPI display as vanilla does.
